description: Scans source code for anti-slop violations using the deterministic rules from ui-craft-detect. Accepts either a `code` string (inline source) or a `path` string (file or directory). Returns findings with severity, rule ID, file, line, and message. These are the 43 deterministic rules only — no taste or aesthetic judgment.

code.description: Inline source code to scan (alternative to path)

path.description: File or directory path to scan (alternative to code)

name: check_anti_slop
title: Check Anti-Slop
